parsed.name: Modbus ADU报文解码器
parsed.description: 用于解析 Modbus 应用数据单元（ADU）报文的软件工具，常用于实验室或工业通信调试中分析串口/RTU 数据流、校验 CRC，并识别写单线圈、写单寄存器、诊断等功能码消息。
parsed.description_en: A software tool for decoding Modbus Application Data Unit (ADU) messages. It is commonly used in laboratory or industrial communication troubleshooting to analyze serial/RTU traffic, verify CRC values, and identify messages such as write single coil, write single register, and diagnostics.

actions.description: 向当前 Modbus ADU 解析过程添加一段接收到的数据。
actions.description_en: Add a received data segment to the current Modbus ADU being decoded.

actions.description: 为尚未标注的指定字节写入解码注释信息。
actions.description_en: Write a decoded annotation for a specified byte that has not yet been annotated.

actions.description: 为最后一个字节写入解码注释信息。
actions.description_en: Write a decoded annotation for the last byte.

actions.description: 结束当前报文解析，并处理消息结束处的溢出或错误标记。
actions.description_en: Close the current message decoding and handle overflow or error marking at the end of the frame.

actions.description: 检查当前 Modbus 报文的 CRC 校验值。
actions.description_en: Check the CRC value of the current Modbus message.

actions.description: 读取并解释指定偏移处的 16 位数据。
actions.description_en: Read and interpret a 16-bit value at the specified offset.

actions.description: 计算当前 Modbus 报文内容的 CRC 值。
actions.description_en: Calculate the CRC value for the current Modbus message content.

actions.description: 解析 Modbus 写单个线圈功能码报文。
actions.description_en: Parse a Modbus write single coil function message.

actions.description: 解析 Modbus 写单个寄存器功能码报文。
actions.description_en: Parse a Modbus write single register function message.

actions.description: 解析 Modbus 诊断功能码报文。
actions.description_en: Parse a Modbus diagnostics function message.

actions.description: 解析 Modbus 掩码写寄存器功能码报文。
actions.description_en: Parse a Modbus mask write register function message.

actions.description: 标记或处理尚未实现解析的合法 Modbus 功能码。
actions.description_en: Mark or handle legal Modbus function codes that are not yet implemented in the parser.
